owner_decision: prospective approval limited to the existing WP-C02-AR TET4 partially active frictionless Signorini benchmark definitions, normalizations, domains and oracles

criteria.definition: E_u(M5)/E_u(M1), where E_u is the relative L2 FE interpolation error against the exact continuum displacement field, integrated on each mesh over the same physical domain.
criteria.domain: M1 and M5; exact continuum field and same domain
criteria.oracle: Exact continuum displacement field evaluated by the frozen quadrature/field oracle
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023, prospective approval in the user instruction
criteria.verification: Native scenario diagnostics plus cross-level report using M1 archived AQ and M5 newly acquired result
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; never infer an endpoint ratio

criteria.definition: E_p(M5)/E_p(M1), where nodal pressure is lambda divided by tributary area, interpolated on bottom triangles and compared in L2 to the exact pressure on the same physical domain with the exact denominator per mesh.
criteria.domain: M1 and M5; bottom contact surface
criteria.oracle: Exact p(x)=4000*max(0,0.5-x)^2 Pa with frozen triangle quadrature
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023, prospective approval in the user instruction
criteria.verification: Native scenario diagnostics plus cross-level report using M1 archived AQ and M5 newly acquired result
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; never infer an endpoint ratio

criteria.definition: Compare strain-energy error norm E_U using the frozen continuum energy norm; also report FE 0.5*u^T*K*u, independently quadrature-integrated FE energy, exact energy, and absolute energy error.
criteria.threshold: E_U(M5) strictly < E_U(M1); error norm in sqrt(J)
criteria.oracle: Frozen exact continuum energy and independent FE quadrature
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023, prospective approval in the user instruction
criteria.verification: Native scenario diagnostics plus cross-level report using archived M1 AQ and new M5 result
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; absent or incomparable energy fields cannot pass

criteria.definition: For every y row, x_h(y)=largest x with lambda>1e-7 N; compare with x*=0.5 m. D_front,max=max_y(abs(x_h(y)-x*)) and report in m and D_front,max/hx. Every row must have interpretable active and open states and a bracket; no row exclusions or multiple active/open transitions.
criteria.threshold: D_front,max/hx <= 1 at each of M2, M3, M4, M5
criteria.domain: M2-M5; M1 report-only because its zero error is an alignment/biactivity alias
criteria.oracle: Analytic straight front x=0.5 m; hx from the fixed mesh plan
criteria.source: wp_c02_ar_mesh_plan.json: proposed_ar_front_gate_requires_owner_approval; protocol report §7.2 criterion prospectif de frontière active
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023, prospective approval in the user instruction
criteria.verification: All-row front trace, brackets, active/open labels, adjacent gap/multiplier values, row count and hx-normalized maximum distance
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; any missing/uninterpretable row or bracket is incomplete and cannot pass

criteria.criterion: Active/open classification locality and partial activity
criteria.definition: Classify active by lambda>1e-7 N, open by gap>1e-10 m, and preserve biactive tolerance cases without forcing a label at x=0.5 m. Every M2-M5 false-positive/false-negative classification must lie within hx; each applicable scenario must have 0<active_count<contact_rows and open_count>0.
criteria.threshold: Every misclassified node distance_to_front/hx <= 1; every row has active and open states; partial-contact counts as above
criteria.domain: Front locality M2-M5; partial contact in each scenario
criteria.oracle: Frozen gap g=0.001+u_z, multiplier lambda, exact contact region x<0.5 m active and x>0.5 m open; biactive line retained
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023, prospective approval in the user instruction
criteria.verification: Full false-positive/negative coordinates and row-level class trace in scenario diagnostic
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; missing class trace or absent active/open region is incomplete/failing evidence

criteria.definition: Apply the frozen AJ gates at each new level: production and full-row independent QP primal/dual feasibility, complementarity, stationarity, production-QP agreement, normalized force/moment balances, work identities, FE matrix/quadrature energy consistency, penetration and gap reconstruction, plus finite reported contact force/moment errors.
criteria.threshold: Exactly the unchanged frozen_aj_acceptance_gates in wp_c02_ar_mesh_plan.json (including gap 1e-10 m, multiplier 1e-7 N, stationarity 1e-6 N, normalized force/moment 1e-9, displacement agreement 1e-9 m, multiplier agreement 1e-6 N, work identities 1e-9 J, FE energy consistency 1e-10 J, and other listed bounds)
criteria.domain: Each M4/M5 scenario, all contact constraints in the independent QP; compare to M1-M3 archived evidence without rerunning them
criteria.oracle: Frozen AJ full-row discrete KKT reference plus exact continuum mechanics/energy and production audit vectors
criteria.source: wp_c02_ar_mesh_plan.json: frozen_aj_acceptance_gates and measurement_protocol.mechanics; tests/unit/test_wpc02_aj_partial_active_contact.py; protocol report §7.1
criteria.owner_authorization: WP-C02-N03-OWNER-CRITERIA-20261023 approves compliance with the existing AR contract; no tolerance is added or changed
criteria.verification: Scenario assertions and report checks on production solver output and independently assembled all-row QP output
criteria.missing_data: NOT_ACQUIRED; any required KKT, force, moment, energy or contact diagnostic absent means incomplete, never PASS

threshold_values.scope: exact AJ test assertions applied at each of M1-M3; AJ coarse/fine endpoint is M1/M3, not M1/M5
threshold_values.partial_contact_counts: 0 < active_count < contact_rows and open_count > 0 at each level
threshold_values.contact_force_and_moment_errors: must be finite and reported; no discretization error threshold in AJ
threshold_values.front_metrics: must be finite and reported; no front acceptance threshold in AJ

scope_limit: This approval is prospective for the existing structured TET4 partially-active contact benchmark only. It does not establish general asymptotic convergence and does not change historical verdicts or authorize FEM execution.
